sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully preserves the required ship applicability, per-loading-condition ownership and evidence path, inclusive expected-result-scaled tolerance envelope with UNITLESS unit, required branch-selection evidence, and conditional alternative logic.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the exact residualStabilityFactorSI comparison (?value >= 1 && ?value <= 1) with an approved tolerance envelope scaled from the expected result (1), not from the reported value. s_i is an externally calculated derived decimal result, so exact equality is not permitted even though the regulatory expected constant is 1; retain the per-case conditional alternative logic, owners, unit UNITLESS, and evidence relationship.

Require alternativeInstrumentApplicable as branch-selection evidence on every loadingConditionCase so a missing selector cannot pass, but do not require it to be false merely because the s_i route is used.
